comments.content: The timeout should be configurable to be any unit of time including 1ms. This will allow the reviewer to run essentially on every commit.
Looks like @whilefoo approved it just at the time of disqualification. At risk of setting a bad precedent: I think if we have no more reviews to go then we can undo the disqualification.

I was reviewing the canReviewPull method in `src/handlers/pull-reviewer.ts` and realize that the one day timeout is hard coded. 
I thought I specified that this should be configurable in the original spec but nonetheless this should be adjustable. 
Once per day is a sensible default but I would love to experiment internally with much more frequency- maybe even on every push (so essentially no timeout?)
We can make a dedicated api key and monitor how expensive it is to run to calibrate the timeout duration.
There's nothing in the spec about push events. The timeout should be sufficient. https://github.com/ubiquity-os-marketplace/daemon-pull-review/issues/7#issuecomment-2677174290
